comp.script:
currentRuleCode.clearValue()
  currentRuleName.clearValue()
  currentRulePeriod.clearValue()
  validFrom.resetValue()
  validTo.resetValue()
  standardCheckbox.setValue([])
  currency.clearValue()
  advancePaymentCodeInput.clearValue()
  taxesCodeInput.clearValue()
  nonpayableCodeInput.clearValue()
  austrianAbroad.setValue([])
  romanianCalculation.setValue([])
  useLastCountry.setValue([])
  deductionLimit.setValue([])
  useSingleCurrency.setValue([])
  countryRefSelect.clearValue()

const queryParamsData = {
    code: additionalData.value.nvi_navigationPayload.code,
    name: additionalData.value.nvi_navigationPayload.name,
    calculation: additionalData.value.nvi_navigationPayload.calculation,
    activeFrom: additionalData.value.nvi_navigationPayload.activeFrom,
    activeTo: additionalData.value.nvi_navigationPayload.activeTo,
    standard: additionalData.value.nvi_navigationPayload.standard === true ? "Yes" : "No",
    currency: additionalData.value.nvi_navigationPayload.currency,
    deductionLimit: additionalData.value.nvi_navigationPayload.deductionLimit,
    taxesCode: additionalData.value.nvi_navigationPayload.taxesCode,
    useLastCountry: additionalData.value.nvi_navigationPayload.useLastCountry,
    nonpayableCode: additionalData.value.nvi_navigationPayload.nonpayableCode,
    advancePaymentCodeInput: additionalData.value.nvi_navigationPayload.advancePaymentCode,
    countryRef: additionalData.value.nvi_navigationPayload.countryRef,
    id: additionalData.value.nvi_navigationPayload.id,
    version: additionalData.value.nvi_navigationPayload.version
  };
 
return queryParamsData;

comp.body:
query myQuery {
  ExpenseRule(orderBy: {createdAt: DESC}, limit: 1, where: {isDeleted: {_eq: false}}) {
    id
    version
    code
    calculationTypeRef
    standard
    activeFrom
    activeTo
    name
    currency {
      code
    }
    currencyRef
    deductionLimit
    taxesCode
    useLastCountry
    nonpayableCode
    advancePaymentCode
    countryRef
    useSingleCurrency
  }
}

transformers.script:
return changeCondition.value ? {
  "expenseRule": {
    "id": additionalData.value.nvi_navigationPayload.id,
    "version": additionalData.value.nvi_navigationPayload.version,
    "code": additionalData.value.nvi_navigationPayload.code,
    "name": currentRuleName.value,
    "calculationTypeRef": currentRulePeriod.value,
    "standard": standardCheckbox.value[0] === true ? true : false || standardCheckbox.value.length > 0 ? true : false,
    "activeFrom": validFrom.value?.concat('T','00:00:00.000Z'),
    "activeTo": validTo.value?.concat('T','00:00:00.000Z'),
    "currencyRef": currency.value,
    "advancePaymentCode": advancePaymentCodeInput.value,
    "taxesCode": taxesCodeInput.value,
    "nonpayableCode": nonpayableCodeInput.value,
    "useLastCountry": useLastCountry.value[0] === true ? true : false || useLastCountry.value.length > 0 ? true : false,
    "deductionLimit": deductionLimit.value[0] === true ? true : false || deductionLimit.value.length > 0 ? true : false,
    "useSingleCurrency": useSingleCurrency.value[0] === true ? true : false || useSingleCurrency.value.length > 0 ? true : false,
    "countryRef": countryRefSelect.value
  },
"changeMode": "UPDATE"
} : {
    "expenseRule": {
      "code": currentRuleCode.value,
      "name": currentRuleName.value,
      "calculationTypeRef": currentRulePeriod.value,
      "standard": standardCheckbox.value[0] ? true : false,
      "activeFrom": validFrom.value?.concat('T','00:00:00.000Z'),
      "activeTo": validTo.value?.concat('T','00:00:00.000Z'),
      "currencyRef": currency.value,
      "advancePaymentCode": advancePaymentCodeInput.value,
      "taxesCode": taxesCodeInput.value,
      "nonpayableCode": nonpayableCodeInput.value,
      "useLastCountry": useLastCountry.value.length > 0 ? true : false,
      "deductionLimit": deductionLimit.value.length > 0 ? true : false,
      "useSingleCurrency": useSingleCurrency.value.length > 0 ? true : false,
      "countryRef": countryRefSelect.value
    },
  "changeMode": "INSERT"
}
